timeline.findings: Large bilateral pelvic masses; mild pelvic free fluid; carcinomatosis not excluded
timeline.keyMeasurements: RLQ/right pelvic mass 9.1 x 8.8 x 9.3 cm; left pelvic mass 8.5 x 5.5 x 4.3 cm
timeline.notes: Pre-op baseline scan

timeline.findings: Complex solid/cystic pelvic mass persists; small ascites
timeline.keyMeasurements: Primary pelvic component 8.7 x 9.6 x 9.4 cm; adjacent right abdominal component 6.6 x 7.0 x 7.4 cm; cyst 8.9 cm
timeline.notes: Second baseline before surgery

timeline.findings: Robotic TAH/BSO with omentectomy and peritoneal disease resection for Krukenberg tumors
timeline.notes: From oncology note chronology

timeline.findings: FOLFOX + bevacizumab x6 cycles, then bevacizumab maintenance Aug-Nov 2023
timeline.notes: Treatment context for later scans

timeline.findings: Small anterior peritoneal nodules concerning for carcinomatosis; midline abdominal wall lesion suspicious for implant
timeline.keyMeasurements: Multiple anterior peritoneal nodules up to 1.3 cm; midline anterior abdominal wall lesion 2.1 x 1.1 cm
timeline.notes: Shift from ovarian masses to peritoneal/abdominal wall disease pattern

timeline.findings: No definite FDG-avid malignancy; abdominal wall lesion remains indeterminate
timeline.keyMeasurements: Midline anterior abdominal wall nodule 2.6 x 1.2 cm (PET report)
timeline.notes: PET relatively quiet despite suspicious lesion

timeline.findings: Excision of abdominal wall mass and omental biopsy confirmed moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma
timeline.notes: From oncology note chronology

timeline.findings: Clear metastatic peritoneal/omental disease; stomach serosal involvement; gastrohepatic + mediastinal adenopathy; indeterminate lung nodules
timeline.keyMeasurements: Gastrohepatic ligament node 2.5 x 1.9 cm; anterior mediastinal node 1.3 x 0.6 cm; left anterior diaphragmatic node 1.3 x 0.9 cm; omental nodule 1.5 x 1.3 cm
timeline.treatment: No active City of Hope systemic therapy yet
timeline.notes: Disease re-framed as upper GI / gastric origin

timeline.findings: Started paclitaxel + ramucirumab; Opdivo requested but initially denied by insurance
timeline.notes: Cycles began 2/12/24

timeline.findings: Persistent gastric wall thickening; some LUQ peritoneal lesions smaller, but other soft tissue / nodal lesions larger; possible pleural lesions
timeline.keyMeasurements: LUQ peritoneal lesions 14 x 11 -> 12 x 10 mm and 14 x 11 -> 11 x 9 mm; obturator node 14 x 4 -> 18 x 8 mm; abdominal wall lesion 44 x 18 -> 42 x 13 mm; serratus lesion 11 x 4 -> 20 x 9 mm
timeline.notes: Transition point toward FOLFIRI/nivolumab

timeline.findings: LLQ biopsy positive for metastatic adenocarcinoma; CLDN18::ARHGAP26 fusion; ARID2 and ERBB3 alterations; PD-L1 CPS 5; MSS/TMB-low
timeline.notes: Useful for trial matching but not a CT scan

timeline.findings: Started FOLFIRI + nivolumab
timeline.notes: Ran through early Aug 2024

timeline.findings: Small bilateral pulmonary nodules; no residual pelvic mass; small free fluid; post-op seroma / edema
timeline.keyMeasurements: Pulmonary nodules 2-4.5 mm; superficial anterior abdominal wall fluid collection 3.6 cm x ~11 mm
timeline.notes: Compared by radiologist to 4/13/2023 rather than to Mar 2024 COH study

timeline.findings: Gastric wall thickening and peritoneal implants remain stable; abdominal wall nodularity stable; lung nodules stable
timeline.keyMeasurements: Mesenteric nodules ~1.3 x 1.0 cm and 1.1 x 1.0 cm; GE-junction node 1.4 x 1.1 cm; diaphragmatic implant 1.2 x 0.7 cm
timeline.notes: City of Hope note described stable disease

timeline.findings: Decrease in density of gastric primary; decrease in peritoneal, abdominal wall, and nodal metastases
timeline.keyMeasurements: Central peritoneal soft tissue 2.5 x 1.1 -> 2.2 x 0.8 cm; caudal left perigastric 1.1 x 1.0 -> 0.9 x 0.7 cm; abdominal wall 2.5 x 1.7 -> 2.0 x 1.5 cm
timeline.notes: Best objective response in this block of scans

timeline.findings: Stomach mildly improved; majority of peritoneal metastases stable to slightly increased; retroperitoneal nodules mildly increased; abdominal wall stable to mildly decreased
timeline.keyMeasurements: Gastrohepatic node 1.6 x 1.4 -> 1.8 x 1.4 cm; left peritoneal metastasis 0.9 x 0.7 -> 1.0 x 0.9 cm; anterior peritoneal nodularity 2.2 x 0.8 -> 1.8 x 0.7 cm; abdominal wall 2.0 x 1.5 -> 2.2 x 0.9 cm
timeline.notes: Suggests response was losing durability

timeline.findings: Massive upper GI bleed with hemorrhagic shock; emergency transfusion, intubation, EGD/cautery, prior embolization of gastroepiploic artery pseudoaneurysm
timeline.notes: Important turning point in treatment course

timeline.findings: Urgent distal gastrectomy en bloc colectomy after GI bleed due to tumor invasion
timeline.notes: Date from oncology note chronology

timeline.findings: Stable post-surgical changes; stable peritoneal thickening and small ascites consistent with residual carcinomatosis
timeline.keyMeasurements: No dominant new measurable lesion reported
timeline.notes: Baseline before IRB 23908 trial entry

timeline.findings: Started EO-3021 (IRB 23908) phase 1 CLDN18.2 trial
timeline.notes: Cycle 1 Day 1 on 10/3/24

timeline.findings: Later reports and oncology note describe interval improvement of peritoneal carcinomatosis by comparison to this scan
timeline.keyMeasurements: Reference comparison scan only (full report not uploaded)
timeline.notes: Included for continuity; not directly reviewed from a stand-alone scan PDF

timeline.findings: Improvement of peritoneal thickening and anterior pelvic peritoneal nodularity; pelvic ascites resolved; lungs stable
timeline.keyMeasurements: Anterior upper pelvis peritoneal nodularity 2.7 x 1.6 -> 2.5 x 1.1 cm; stable small bilateral pulmonary nodules up to 5 mm
timeline.notes: Treating clinician note: 'IMPROVING'

timeline.findings: Stable postop changes; stable peritoneal nodules and abdominal wall nodularity; lung nodules overall stable/slightly increased
timeline.keyMeasurements: Anterior pelvic peritoneal soft tissue 2.5 x 1.3 cm; pulmonary nodules around 0.5 x 0.4 cm
timeline.notes: Treating clinician note interpreted as stable disease

timeline.findings: New/enlarging liver lesions while peritoneal disease remains stable; lungs stable
timeline.keyMeasurements: Segment 3 liver lesion 8 mm; segment 7 liver lesion ~18 x 11 mm; additional irregular right hepatic lobe area up to ~45 x 32 mm; anterior pelvic peritoneal soft tissue 2.3 x 1.1 cm
timeline.notes: Progression driven mainly by liver findings

timeline.findings: Stable postop changes, stable peritoneal nodules, stable abdominal wall nodularity, no new/enlarging metastatic site
timeline.keyMeasurements: Peritoneal nodularity near right liver tip 1.1 x 0.5 cm; anterior upper pelvis 2.3 x 1.2 cm
timeline.notes: Liver finding described as nonspecific / unchanged

timeline.findings: Stable postop changes; stable peritoneal nodules; stable lung nodules; stable tiny liver/perihepatic findings
timeline.keyMeasurements: Right peritoneal nodule 1.1 x 0.5 cm; anterior pelvic peritoneal soft tissue 2.7 x 1.4 cm; tiny liver focus ~5 mm
timeline.notes: Treating clinician note explicitly says stable disease

timeline.findings: EO-3021 continued under single-patient IND / SPIND 25429 after sponsor stopped manufacturing
timeline.notes: Bridge period while evaluating next options

timeline.findings: Multiple scattered pulmonary nodules up to 6 mm, slightly progressed versus prior 2024 scans; no adenopathy
timeline.keyMeasurements: Pulmonary nodules up to 6 mm
timeline.notes: Report compared to 8/18/2024 and 4/20/2024 rather than to spring 2025 COH scans

timeline.findings: Started TORL-2-307 Claudin 18.2 ADC (TRIO-052); q3wk with G-CSF support
timeline.notes: Cycle 1 Day 1 8/26/25

timeline.findings: Stable exam versus Aug 2025; pulmonary nodules stable; subtle bladder dome/mesenteric mass becomes target lesion
timeline.keyMeasurements: Bladder dome/mesenteric mass 21 x 17 mm; pulmonary nodules up to 6 mm stable
timeline.notes: RECIST baseline for this trial

timeline.findings: Pulmonary nodules minimally increased; bladder dome/mesenteric mass minimally increased
timeline.keyMeasurements: Bladder dome/mesenteric mass 24 x 17 mm; representative lung nodules 4 mm from 3 mm
timeline.notes: Could represent early loss of control

timeline.findings: Overall progression of disease with increased pulmonary nodules and larger bladder dome/mesenteric mass
timeline.keyMeasurements: Bladder dome/mesenteric mass 28 x 28 mm; representative lung nodules 5-7 mm
timeline.notes: Treating clinician note says treatment continued beyond progression

timeline.findings: Review of evolution and options after progression: Enhertu if HER2 amplified, givastomig if CLDN18 positive, additional trial screening
timeline.notes: Also confirms chronology of prior regimens

timeline.findings: Overall progression again with larger bladder dome/mesenteric mass and minimally larger lung nodules
timeline.keyMeasurements: Bladder dome/mesenteric mass 35 x 27 mm; representative RML pulmonary nodule 6.5 mm
timeline.notes: Dominant measurable lesion continues to enlarge

timeline.findings: Baseline trial scan showing pulmonary metastases, peritoneal carcinomatosis, bladder dome lesion, left ureteral tumor implant, trace ascites
timeline.keyMeasurements: RML pulmonary nodule 10 x 7 mm; bladder dome lesion 38 x 24 mm; SOD 48
timeline.notes: RECIST baseline before starting trial therapy

timeline.findings: Overall stable metastatic disease with unchanged pulmonary nodules, stable peritoneal disease, stable ureteral implant, no new lesions
timeline.keyMeasurements: RML pulmonary nodule 10 x 8 mm; bladder dome lesion 38 x 21 mm; SOD 48
timeline.notes: First post-treatment scan demonstrates disease stability without progression

timeline.findings: Overall stable metastatic disease with unchanged pulmonary nodules, grossly unchanged peritoneal disease, stable left ureteral implant, no new lesions; dominant bladder dome lesion slightly smaller
timeline.keyMeasurements: RML pulmonary nodule 10 x 7 mm; bladder dome lesion 31 x 21 mm; RECIST SOD 41 (-15% from baseline)
timeline.notes: Post-cycle 4 scan remains stable; target SOD improved from 48 to 41 but not enough for partial response threshold

treatments.context: Initial systemic treatment while tumor was still thought ovarian in origin

treatments.regimen: 1 week XRT to abdominal wall mass
treatments.context: Mentioned in follow-up note before 6/26 response scan

Massive GI bleed -> transfusion/intubation -> urgent distal gastrectomy en bloc colectomy

treatments.context: CLDN18.2 trial; best radiographic response late 2024 / early 2025

treatments.regimen: Zolbetuximab / FOLFOX plan exists in chart
treatments.context: Listed as treatment plan / backup option
New target lesion becomes bladder dome/mesenteric mass; progression by Dec 2025
Investigational solid tumor trial after progression on TORL-2-307; 6/24/26 post-cycle 4 CT remains RECIST stable disease with target SOD 41 (-15% from baseline)
